title: Amazing Aromatic Portuguese Chicken Skewers
description: Tangy and molten, these Portuguese chicken skewers are full of energizing flavor, featuring bouillon cubes and a char-grill yang, all while being FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the dissolved bouillon cubes, olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Brush the skewers with lemon juice during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
